<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<addon id="plugin.video.xtreammate"
       name="XCMate"
       version="0.1.29.51"
       provider-name="GS Media">

  <requires>
    <import addon="xbmc.python" version="3.0.0"/>
    <import addon="script.module.pil" version="5.1.0"/>
    <import addon="script.module.requests" version="2.27.0" optional="true"/>

</requires>

  <extension point="xbmc.python.pluginsource" library="default.py">
    <provides>video audio</provides>
  </extension>

  <extension point="xbmc.service" library="service.py" start="startup"/>

  <extension point="xbmc.addon.metadata">
    <summary lang="en_GB">XCMate – TV setup wizard for Xtream, M3U and Stalker</summary>
    <summary lang="de_DE">XCMate – IPTV-Einrichtungsassistent mit Xtream, M3U und Stalker</summary>
    <description lang="en_GB">
      Independent GPL-licensed derivative of mr-evil1 TiViMate Kodi, featuring a guided IPTV import process and on-video remote-control live channel and category navigation.
      Features: Multiple M3U playlists, Xtream Codes API (Live/VOD/Series),
      XMLTV EPG, channel groups, favourites, search, catch-up, recordings,
      reminders, sleep timer.
    </description>
    <description lang="de_DE">
      Eigenständiger GPL-Fork von mr-evil1 TiViMate Kodi mit geführter IPTV-Einrichtung und Fernbedienungssteuerung über laufendem Live-TV.
      Funktionen: Mehrere M3U-Playlists, Xtream-Codes-API (Live/VOD/Serien),
      XMLTV-EPG, Sendergruppen, Favoriten, Suche, Catch-up, Aufnahmen,
      Erinnerungen, Sleep-Timer.
    </description>
    <platform>all</platform>
    <license>GPL-2.0-only</license>
    <defaultlanguage>resource.language.en_gb</defaultlanguage>
    <forum>https://forum.kodi.tv</forum>
    <website>https://kodi.tv</website>
    <source>https://github.com/artattakk-creator/kodi-noodleprivate</source>
    <news>German and English language support; Language filter; Xtream auto-detection; Parallel search</news>
    <assets>
      <icon>icon-81da1003a2753ec6.png</icon>
      <fanart>fanart.jpg</fanart>
    </assets>
  </extension>

</addon>

0.1.29.51

  Skinshortcuts Home slot. Preserve occupied movie/series bindings and reload hooks.
  Explicit confirmation, private original/candidate SHA256, safe restore.
- Four-file opt-in BINGIE 2.2.3 adapter: real Home programme Hero and small
  horizontal station logos, plus direct native widget candidates. No automatic
  skin/profile modification, startup apply or native player rewrite.

  EPG/artwork data. Full group, no provider/category fallback, focus never tunes.

0.1.29.49 (widget selection hotfix #252; Android NOT_TESTED)
- Settings > Appearance and display > Widgets lists three real folders:
  Live TV - start group, Movies - latest movies, Series - latest series.
- BINGIE/skinshortcuts can browse and select the existing widget endpoints;
  the skin's own picker saves the binding. No plugin-URL textviewer substitute.

  for bookmarked RunPlugin entries. Existing status/Hero preview remain separate.
- No skin/profile edits or widget URL/reload-hook changes; preserve all .48 data,
  media widgets and their automatic refresh. No automatic installation or merge.

0.1.29.48 (cumulative review candidate; Android .48 NOT_TESTED)
- #250/#249: OS-held service singleton, local-first startup phases, bounded
  maintenance and optional network prefetch. No claim of a proven native
  Android crash fix without a crash/ANR trace and device acceptance.

  protection, finite native-init/discovery deadlines, 3s request timeout and no

- Wizard Save preserves committed EPG source archive, XMLTV images, cast,
  director and additive common facts; external-only sources retain correct rank.
  Existing populated guides remain behind the verified-backup gate.

- Source-qualified EPG assignment directly from Guide context or visible button:
  real grid preview in RAM, explicit Save/Cancel, legacy mapping compatibility.
- Propagate verified rich event data, protect direct XMLTV icons from nested
  rating icons, rotate event-art jobs independently of widget repaint, require
  the image decoder dependency and add bounded privacy-safe evidence.
- Covermanager uses existing candidates immediately, supports verified offline
  choices and explicit provider refresh; safe credentialless public image
  redirects revalidate DNS/TLS, deny downgrade/private hosts and limit hops.
- Native Live-only sender-strip/large-Hero preview. Optional BINGIE include is
  REVIEW_ONLY / BLOCKED_SKIN_INTEGRATION pending actual skin review/approval.
  Working movie/series widgets, native click paths and reload hooks unchanged.
- No reset, no existing image deletion, no device action, no auto-merge/release.

0.1.29.47 (cumulative review candidate; Android .47 NOT_TESTED)

0.1.29.38 (cumulative Android test candidate; not released)

0.1.29.36 – kumulativer Such-/Live-/Genre-Kandidat mit Artwork-Pipeline-Reparatur
- Artwork: backend-neutral local image reads/writes/capacity with SHA256 readback; stable files, no external target switch or migration in .36 (#106 preparation for .37).
- #168 Pflichtumfang: Bildaufträge unter dem geschützten Importfreiraum dauerhaft speichern; vollständige Bildreserve unverändert vor HTTP und Dateiablage prüfen. Vorhandene Queue ohne neue UI-Anfrage wieder bedienen. Scanfortschritt erst nach bestätigter Enqueue-Transaktion; alte fertige Scans ausschließlich bei leerer Queue einmalig seitenweise nachholen, keine fehlgeschlagenen Altjobs global zurücksetzen.

- Bildstatus: exakte freie/gesamte Bytes, Bildreserve/Budget und separate Queue-Metadatenreserve; Source-Felder, Enqueue, Worker/Lease, letzte READY-/Versuchszeit und feste Netzwerk-/DB-/Speichercodes. Veraltete/fehlende Dienstbeobachtung als UNKNOWN, niemals als Erfolg. Keine privaten URLs/IDs/Token im Export.
- #140/#127: vorhandene Kurzzeitcache-Dateien einmal ermitteln, fehlende Dateien überspringen; lokale Jetzt-Titel und Sendernamen weiter inkrementell. Unlesbare Inventare behalten den Cache-only-Fallback. Zusätzliche numerische Suchphasen, keine Suchbegriffe in Logs.
- #120/#35: Startsender aus aktivierter lokaler Indexzeile, kein doppeltes Vollkatalog-Lesen. Legacy-Cache bleibt erhalten. Resolver und direkter Start behalten ihre bisherigen Kodi-Player-Verträge.
- #17/#35: Sender-Metadaten aus SQLite; neu aktivierte, noch nicht indexierte Gruppen behalten den bisherigen lokalen Katalog. Guide-Worker und Startup-Preload lesen begrenzte Now/Next-Viewport-Daten statt erneut das ganze Portal-JSON. Render/Layout/Fernbedienung unverändert.
- #75: Stop/Home pro Live-Session über Fensterinstanzen hinweg verriegeln; vorhandene Home-Ansicht ohne erneute explizite Plugin-URL wiederverwenden. Player-State-Races geschützt messen; fremde Wiedergabe nicht beenden. #97 bleibt geschlossen.
- Anonyme monotone Messphasen für Route/Player/Info/Mini; Plugin-Eingang und Playerzustand sind keine physische IR-/First-Frame-Messung. Host-Vergleich und Android S36-01–12 separat dokumentiert, alle Android-Gates S36/GENRE/ART36 auf Kodi 21.2 und 21.3 NOT_TESTED.
- #159: echte VOD-/Serien-Genresuche mit konservativen Aliasen und Titelpriorität. Zwei additive abgeleitete SQLite-Tabellen, wiederaufnehmbare Hintergrund-Nachindizierung in 128er-Batches, alte Kataloge bleiben lesbar. Kein JSON-Vollscan während Suche. Vor Abschluss ehrlicher Indexstatus, begrenzte Aktualisierung ohne neuen Live-Scan.
- #111: bestehender gezielter Einzelbild-Retry und alle READY-Bilder erhalten. Neue externe TMDb-/Bildsuche weiterhin nicht enthalten; die reguläre Provider-Bilderpipeline #168 ist jetzt Pflichtbestand. Keine Datenmigration, kein Reset, keine Änderung an Downloads/Aufnahmen, kein automatischer Merge/Release/OTA.

0.1.29.35 – schnelle Live-Suche und gezielte Guide-Navigation (Testkandidat)

"""Durable explicit Xtream group worklist; never refresh unrelated groups.

Small internal JSON intents avoid depending on a locked catalogue DB when the
user saves group selection. Service owns network/index IO and bounded retries.
"""
import json
import os
import tempfile
import time
import uuid
from profile_transaction import writing,reading


def path():
    from utils import addon_data_dir
    return os.path.join(addon_data_dir(),'catalog_delta_v1.json')


def _read():
    try:
        with open(path(),encoding='utf-8') as stream:value=json.load(stream)
        if value.get('version')==1 and isinstance(value.get('jobs'),dict):return value
    except FileNotFoundError:pass
    return dict(version=1,jobs={})


def _save(value):
    from import_budget import check_space
    data=json.dumps(value,sort_keys=True).encode();check_space(path(),len(data)*2+65536)
    fd,temp=tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.catalog-delta-',dir=os.path.dirname(path()))
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as stream:stream.write(data);stream.flush();os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        os.replace(temp,path());temp=''
    finally:
        if temp:
            try:os.unlink(temp)
            except OSError:pass


def request(portal,kind,cid):
    if kind not in ('live','vod','series') or portal.get('type')!='xtream':return
    key=json.dumps([str(portal['id']),kind,str(cid)])
    with writing(timeout=.1):
        value=_read();prior=value['jobs'].get(key)
        if prior and prior['code']=='RUNNING' and prior['next_at']>time.time():return
        value['jobs'][key]=dict(pid=str(portal['id']),kind=kind,cid=str(cid),code='PENDING',attempts=0,next_at=0,updated=time.time(),stored=0,received=0)
        _save(value)


def states(pid,kind):
    with reading(timeout=.05):
        rows=[row for row in _read()['jobs'].values() if row['pid']==str(pid) and row['kind']==kind]
    return sorted(rows,key=lambda row:row['updated'],reverse=True)


def pending(pid,kind):return any(row['code'] in ('PENDING','RUNNING') for row in states(pid,kind))


def run_next(cancel=lambda:False):
    if not os.path.isfile(path()) or cancel():return False
    now=time.time()
    with writing(timeout=.1):
        value=_read();selected=next(((key,row) for key,row in value['jobs'].items() if row['code'] in ('PENDING','RUNNING','FAILED') and row['attempts']<3 and row['next_at']<=now),None)
        if selected is None:return False
        key,job=selected;job=dict(job,code='RUNNING',next_at=now+330,updated=now,owner=uuid.uuid4().hex);value['jobs'][key]=job;_save(value)
    try:
        from portals import get_by_id
        from xtream import XtreamClient
        from library_index import sync_kind,Reader,sync_state

        from group_selection import load

        client=XtreamClient(portal['xc_host'],portal['xc_user'],portal['xc_pass'])
        sync_kind(portal,client,job['kind'],job['cid'],cancel=cancel,max_groups=1,only_categories={job['cid']})
        statuses=sync_state(job['pid'],job['kind'])

"""Selected-channel long DB evidence. Worker-only, bounded, strictly read-only."""

from urllib.parse import quote
from localization import tr


def _stamp(value):

def inspect(portal,row,origin,cursor,focus,client=None,snapshot=None):

    manual=config.get('mappings',{}).get(channel['sid'])
    ids=[str(manual)] if manual else list(dict.fromkeys([str(channel['sid']),str(channel.get('epg_channel_id') or '')]))
    lines=[tr(33121),safe_name(channel['name'])+' | SID: '+safe_name(channel['sid']),
           'Viewport: '+str(row['mapping'])+' | CID: '+safe_name(row.get('epg_id'),'—'),
           'Cursor: '+_stamp(cursor)+' | origin: '+_stamp(origin)+' | focus: '+str(int(focus)),
           'guide_v1.sqlite (read-only) | '+('MANUAL' if manual else 'AUTO'),
           'Provider EPG-ID: '+safe_name(channel.get('epg_channel_id'),'—')]
    if snapshot:lines.append('loading='+str(bool(snapshot['loading']))+' | cells='+str(int(snapshot['cells'])))

            db.row_factory=sqlite3.Row

            # Same alias candidates/order as the viewport. Unlike the viewport,
            # coverage is queried across the full stored horizon, including gaps.
            for ident in ids:
                if not ident:continue
                alias=db.execute('SELECT cid FROM guide_alias WHERE pid=? AND alias=?',(portal['id'],ident)).fetchone()
                cid=alias[0] if alias else ident;args=(portal['id'],cid)
                lines+=['','Alias: '+safe_name(ident)+' → CID: '+safe_name(cid)]
                first=db.execute('SELECT start,stop,title FROM programmes WHERE pid=? AND cid=? ORDER BY start,stop LIMIT 1',args).fetchone()
                last=db.execute('SELECT start,stop,title FROM programmes WHERE pid=? AND cid=? ORDER BY start DESC,stop DESC LIMIT 1',args).fetchone()
                sources=db.execute('SELECT source,min(start),max(stop),count(*) FROM programmes WHERE pid=? AND cid=? GROUP BY source',args).fetchall()
                lines.append('Erster / First: '+(_stamp(first['start'])+' – '+_stamp(first['stop'])+' | '+first['title'] if first else '—'))
                lines.append('Letzter / Last: '+(_stamp(last['start'])+' – '+_stamp(last['stop'])+' | '+last['title'] if last else '—'))
                # Full coverage equivalent to horizon(pid,cid), without its
                # schema-writing connect(). Last stop may differ from last start.
                lines.append('Programme: '+str(sum(s['count(*)'] for s in sources)))
                for source in sources:
                    index=source['source'];records=config.get('sources',[])
                    record=records[index-1] if 0<index<=len(records) else None
                    entry=state.get(source_key(record) if record else 'provider',{})
                    name=safe_name(record.get('name')) if record else ('Provider' if index==0 else 'Source '+str(index))
                    lines.append('Quelle / Source: '+name+' | '+str(entry.get('code','UNKNOWN'))+' | '+str(source['count(*)'])+' | '+_stamp(source['min(start)'])+' → '+_stamp(source['max(stop)'])+' | Erfolg / Success: '+_stamp(entry.get('last_success')))
                days=db.execute("SELECT date(start,'unixepoch','localtime'),count(*) FROM programmes WHERE pid=? AND cid=? GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 12",args).fetchall()
                lines.append('Tage / Days: '+', '.join(str(d[0])+': '+str(d[1]) for d in days))
                local=time.localtime(cursor);after=int(time.mktime((local.tm_year,local.tm_mon,local.tm_mday,14,0,0,0,0,-1)))
                future=db.execute('SELECT start,stop,title FROM programmes WHERE pid=? AND cid=? AND stop>? ORDER BY start,stop LIMIT 3',args+(after,)).fetchall()
                lines.append('Nach / After '+_stamp(after)+':')

    if portal.get('type')!='xtream': return False

"""Local, versioned SQLite catalog. Writers run in workers; readers never HTTP.

The index contains IDs and provider metadata, never playable stream URLs.
No dependency on SQLite FTS/JSON extensions (not guaranteed by Android Kodi).
"""
import hashlib
import json
import os
import sqlite3
import time
import unicodedata

CATALOGS={'live':('get_live_streams','get_live_categories','stream_id'),
          'vod':('get_vod_streams','get_vod_categories','stream_id'),
          'series':('get_series','get_series_categories','series_id')}
FIELDS=('name','stream_icon','cover','cover_big','movie_image','backdrop_path','plot','description',
        'year','releaseDate','genre','rating','rating_5based','duration','duration_secs',
        'container_extension','epg_channel_id','source_key','series_flat',
        'language','languages','quality','video_quality','width','height',
        'num_seasons','season_count','seasons_count','original_name','original_title')
BATCH_ROWS=256


def normalized(value):
    value=unicodedata.normalize('NFKD',str(value or '').casefold())
    return ' '.join(''.join(c for c in value if not unicodedata.combining(c)).split())


def path():
    from utils import addon_data_dir
    return os.path.join(addon_data_dir(),'library_v1.sqlite')


def connect(filename=None, write=False,timeout=2):
    filename=filename or path()
    if not write and not os.path.isfile(filename): return None
    db=sqlite3.connect(filename,timeout=timeout)
    db.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
    if write:
        from import_budget import check_space
        check_space(filename)
        db.execute('PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL')
        db.execute('PRAGMA max_page_count=2147483646')
        db.executescript('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS catalog(
          pid TEXT, kind TEXT, revision TEXT, updated REAL, PRIMARY KEY(pid,kind));
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS groups(pid TEXT, kind TEXT, cid TEXT, title TEXT,
          ordinal INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(pid,kind,cid));
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS titles(pid TEXT, kind TEXT, sid TEXT, cid TEXT,
          ordinal INTEGER, title TEXT, search TEXT, added INTEGER, payload TEXT,
          PRIMARY KEY(pid,kind,sid));
          CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS category_titles ON titles(pid,kind,cid,ordinal);
          CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS recent_titles ON titles(pid,kind,added DESC,ordinal);
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS heads(pid TEXT,kind TEXT,cid TEXT,generation TEXT,
            updated REAL,PRIMARY KEY(pid,kind,cid));
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS items_v2(pid TEXT,kind TEXT,sid TEXT,cid TEXT,generation TEXT,
            ordinal INTEGER,title TEXT,search TEXT,added INTEGER,payload TEXT,
            PRIMARY KEY(pid,kind,cid,generation,sid));
          CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS group_order_v2 ON items_v2(pid,kind,cid,generation,ordinal);
          CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS recent_v2 ON items_v2(pid,kind,added DESC);
          CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS identity_v2 ON items_v2(pid,kind,sid);
          CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS readable_titles AS
            SELECT i.pid,i.kind,i.sid,i.cid,i.ordinal,i.title,i.search,i.added,i.payload
              FROM items_v2 i JOIN heads h USING(pid,kind,cid,generation)
            UNION ALL SELECT t.* FROM titles t WHERE NOT EXISTS
              (SELECT 1 FROM heads h WHERE h.pid=t.pid AND h.kind=t.kind AND h.cid=t.cid);
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sync_status(pid TEXT,kind TEXT,cid TEXT,code TEXT,
            updated REAL,received INTEGER,stored INTEGER,discarded INTEGER,error TEXT,
            PRIMARY KEY(pid,kind,cid));
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sync_requests(pid TEXT,kind TEXT,priority INTEGER,
            preferred TEXT,force INTEGER,requested REAL,PRIMARY KEY(pid,kind));
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sync_leases(pid TEXT,kind TEXT,owner TEXT,until REAL,
            PRIMARY KEY(pid,kind));''')
    return db


def revision(client, actions):
    """File metadata, not repeated deserialization of huge catalog JSON files."""
    from utils import cache_dir, _private_cache_dir, addon_data_dir
    roots=set((cache_dir(),_private_cache_dir()))
    paths=[os.path.join(root,client._cache_key(a)+'.json') for root in roots for a in actions]
    paths.append(os.path.join(addon_data_dir(),'xtreammate_groups.json'))
    values=[]
    for filename in paths:
        try:
            st=os.stat(filename); values.append((filename,st.st_mtime_ns,st.st_size))
        except OSError: values.append((filename,0,0))
    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(sorted(values)).encode()).hexdigest()


def replace_catalog(pid,kind,entries,groups,allowed=None,seen=None,revision_id='',filename=None):
    from latest_media import added_timestamp
    if entries is None or isinstance(entries,(str,bytes,dict)): return False
    _,_,id_key=CATALOGS[kind]
    allowed=None if allowed is None else set(map(str,allowed))
    def rows():
        unique=set()
        for ordinal,item in enumerate(entries):
            if not isinstance(item,dict): continue
            sid=str(item.get(id_key) or ''); cid=str(item.get('category_id') or '')
            if not sid or sid in unique or (allowed is not None and cid not in allowed): continue
            unique.add(sid)
            title=str(item.get('name') or sid)[:512]
            payload={k:(item[k][:4096] if isinstance(item[k],str) else item[k][:8] if isinstance(item[k],list) else item[k])
                     for k in FIELDS if k in item}
            payload.update(sid=sid,category_id=cid,name=title,kind=kind)
            added=added_timestamp(item.get('added')) or added_timestamp(item.get('date_added')) or (seen or {}).get(sid)
            payload['added_at']=added
            yield (str(pid),kind,sid,cid,ordinal,title,normalized(title),added,json.dumps(payload))
    db=connect(filename,write=True)
    try:
        with db:
            db.execute('DELETE FROM heads WHERE pid=? AND kind=?',(pid,kind))
            db.execute('DELETE FROM items_v2 WHERE pid=? AND kind=?',(pid,kind))
            db.execute('DELETE FROM titles WHERE pid=? AND kind=?',(pid,kind))
            db.execute('DELETE FROM groups WHERE pid=? AND kind=?',(pid,kind))
            db.executemany('INSERT INTO titles VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',rows())
            db.executemany('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO groups VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)',[
                (pid,kind,str(g['category_id']),str(g.get('category_name') or g['category_id']),i)
                for i,g in enumerate(groups or []) if isinstance(g,dict) and g.get('category_id') is not None
                and (allowed is None or str(g['category_id']) in allowed)])
            db.execute('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO catalog VALUES(?,?,?,?)',(pid,kind,revision_id,time.time()))
        return True
    finally: db.close()


def refresh(portal,client,kinds=None):
    from group_selection import enabled_ids,load
    from latest_media import first_seen
    for kind in (kinds or CATALOGS):
        action,group_action,_=CATALOGS[kind]
        if not portal.get({'live':'include_live','vod':'include_vod','series':'include_series'}[kind],True):
            replace_catalog(portal['id'],kind,[],[])
            continue
        rev=revision(client,(action,group_action))
        state=Reader(portal['id']).state(kind)
        if state and state['revision']==rev: continue
        entries=client.get_cached_catalog(action)
        if not isinstance(entries,list): continue  # Keep previous valid snapshot.
        if not entries and state: continue  # Empty provider result must not empty widgets.
        groups=client.get_cached_catalog(group_action)
        if not isinstance(groups,list):
            groups=[{'category_id':cid,'category_name':cid} for cid in dict.fromkeys(
                str(e.get('category_id') or '') for e in entries if isinstance(e,dict))]
        allowed=enabled_ids(portal['id'],kind,groups)
        seen=first_seen(client._cache_key(action),action,entries) if kind!='live' else {}
        replace_catalog(portal['id'],kind,entries,groups,allowed,seen,rev)


class IndexReadError(RuntimeError):
    pass


class Reader:
    def __init__(self,pid,filename=None,timeout=2,query_seconds=None):
        self.pid,self.filename=str(pid),filename
        self._selections={}
        self.timeout,self.query_seconds=timeout,query_seconds

    def _filter(self,kind):
        from group_selection import enabled_ids
        groups=self._query('SELECT cid FROM groups WHERE pid=? AND kind=?',(self.pid,kind))
        self._selections[kind]=enabled_ids(self.pid,kind,[{'category_id':g['cid']} for g in groups])
        return ' AND cid IN (SELECT cid FROM selected_categories)'

    def _query(self,sql,args=(),kind=None):
        db=None
        try:
            db=connect(self.filename, timeout=self.timeout)
            if db is None: return []
            # A large catalogue or a temporarily locked legacy database must
            # not monopolize a skin widget/UI invocation. No partial result is
            # published; the caller receives an explicit, retryable error.
            if self.query_seconds is not None:
                deadline=time.monotonic()+self.query_seconds
                db.set_progress_handler(lambda: int(time.monotonic()>=deadline),1000)
            if 'titles' in sql and db.execute("SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE name='readable_titles'").fetchone():
                sql=sql.replace('FROM titles','FROM readable_titles')
            if kind is not None:
                db.execute('CREATE TEMP TABLE selected_categories(cid TEXT PRIMARY KEY)')
                db.executemany('INSERT INTO selected_categories VALUES(?)',[(cid,) for cid in self._selections[kind]])
            return [dict(r) for r in db.execute(sql,args)]
        except sqlite3.Error as exc: raise IndexReadError(type(exc).__name__) from exc
        finally:
            if db is not None: db.close()

    def state(self,kind):
        rows=self._query('SELECT * FROM catalog WHERE pid=? AND kind=?',(self.pid,kind))
        return rows[0] if rows else None

    def groups(self,kind):
        return self._query('SELECT * FROM groups WHERE pid=? AND kind=?'+self._filter(kind)+' ORDER BY ordinal',(self.pid,kind),kind)

    def page(self,kind,query='',category=None,recent=False,offset=0,limit=48,pin=None,include_undated=False):
        where='pid=? AND kind=?'+self._filter(kind); args=[self.pid,kind]
        terms=[];term_args=[]
        for token in normalized(query).split():
            terms.append("search LIKE ? ESCAPE '\\'")
            term_args.append('%'+token.replace('\\','\\\\').replace('%','\\%').replace('_','\\_')+'%')
        title_where=' AND '.join(terms) or '1'
        genre=None
        if query and kind in ('vod','series'):
            from genre_search import clause
            genre=clause(self,kind,query)
        if genre:
            where+=' AND (('+title_where+') OR ('+genre[0]+'))'
            args+=term_args+genre[1]
        elif terms:
            where+=' AND '+title_where;args+=term_args
        if category is not None: where+=' AND cid=?'; args.append(str(category))
        if recent and not include_undated: where+=' AND added IS NOT NULL'
        counts=self._query('SELECT count(DISTINCT sid) AS n FROM titles AS results WHERE '+where,args,kind)
        total=counts[0]['n'] if counts else 0
        order='added IS NULL,added DESC,ordinal' if recent else 'ordinal'
        if genre:
            order='CASE WHEN search=? THEN 0 WHEN '+title_where+' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,'+order
            args=args+[normalized(query)]+term_args
        if pin:
            order='CASE WHEN sid=? THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,'+order
            args=args[:-(1+len(term_args))]+[str(pin)]+args[-(1+len(term_args)):] if genre else args+[str(pin)]
        rows=self._query('SELECT payload FROM titles AS results WHERE '+where+' GROUP BY sid ORDER BY '+order+' LIMIT ? OFFSET ?',
                         args+[max(1,min(int(limit),100)),max(0,int(offset))],kind)
        return [json.loads(r['payload']) for r in rows],total

    def get(self,kind,sid):
        rows=self._query('SELECT payload FROM titles WHERE pid=? AND kind=? AND sid=?'+self._filter(kind),(self.pid,kind,str(sid)),kind)
        return json.loads(rows[0]['payload']) if rows else None

    def position(self,kind,sid,category):
        """Read-only ordinal position in one allowed group; never pin/reorder."""
        where='pid=? AND kind=? AND cid=?'+self._filter(kind)
        args=[self.pid,kind,str(category)]
        rows=self._query('SELECT MIN(ordinal) AS n FROM titles WHERE '+where+' AND sid=?',args+[str(sid)],kind)
        ordinal=rows[0]['n'] if rows else None
        if ordinal is None:return None
        rows=self._query('SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sid) AS n FROM titles WHERE '+where+' AND ordinal<?',args+[ordinal],kind)
        return rows[0]['n'] if rows else None

    def rail(self,kind,offset=0,limit=24,keep=100):
        keep=max(24,min(int(keep),500))
        rows,total=self.page(kind,recent=True,include_undated=True,offset=offset,limit=min(limit,max(1,keep-offset)))
        return (rows if offset<keep else []),min(total,keep)


def initial_group(portal,groups,start_channel=None,last=''):
    allowed={str(g.get('cid',g.get('category_id',''))) for g in groups}
    candidates=[str((start_channel or {}).get('category_id') or ''),
                str(portal.get('start_group_id') or ''),str(last)]
    return next((cid for cid in candidates if cid in allowed),
                str(groups[0].get('cid',groups[0].get('category_id',''))) if groups else '')


def import_group(pid,kind,cid,entries,filename=None,cancel=lambda:False,progress=None,allowed=None):
    """Batch-committed staging; one small head swap exposes a complete group.

    Staging and previous generation coexist until validation finishes. A crash
    never publishes half JSON; a later sync restarts from the category endpoint.
    Unique SQLite keys replace unbounded Python duplicate/first-seen sets.
    """
    import uuid
    from latest_media import added_timestamp
    from import_budget import check_space
    cid,pid=str(cid),str(pid)
    generation=uuid.uuid4().hex
    db=connect(filename,write=True); target=filename or path()
    action,_,id_key=CATALOGS[kind]
    known_categories={r[0] for r in db.execute('SELECT cid FROM heads WHERE pid=? AND kind=? UNION SELECT cid FROM titles WHERE pid=? AND kind=?',(pid,kind,pid,kind))}
    received=stored=discarded=0; batch=[];touched=set()
    allowed={cid} if allowed is None else set(map(str,allowed))
    def flush():
        nonlocal stored
        if not batch: return
        check_space(target,sum(len(row[-1]) for row in batch)*4)
        previous_changes=db.total_changes
        with db: db.executemany('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO items_v2 VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',batch)
        stored+=db.total_changes-previous_changes
        batch.clear()
        if progress: progress(received,stored,discarded)
    try:
        # Clean only this group's abandoned, invisible generations. Bounded
        # deletion also avoids a giant cleanup transaction after a crash.
        _prune(db,pid,kind,cid)
        for item in entries:
            if cancel(): raise InterruptedError('catalogue import cancelled')
            received+=1
            if progress and received % BATCH_ROWS == 0: progress(received,stored,discarded)
            if not isinstance(item,dict): continue
            category=str(item.get('category_id') or '')
            if category not in allowed: discarded+=1;continue
            sid=str(item.get(id_key) or '')[:256]
            if not sid: continue
            title=str(item.get('name') or sid)[:512]
            payload={}
            for key in FIELDS:
                value=item.get(key)
                if isinstance(value,str): payload[key]=value[:4096]
                elif isinstance(value,(int,float,bool)) or value is None: payload[key]=value
                elif isinstance(value,list): payload[key]=[str(v)[:4096] for v in value[:8] if isinstance(v,(str,int,float))]
            added=added_timestamp(item.get('added')) or added_timestamp(item.get('date_added'))
            if not added:
                previous=db.execute('SELECT added FROM readable_titles WHERE pid=? AND kind=? AND sid=? LIMIT 1',
                                    (pid,kind,sid)).fetchone()
                added=previous[0] if previous else (int(time.time()) if category in known_categories else None)
            payload.update(sid=sid,category_id=category,name=title,kind=kind,added_at=added)
            touched.add(category)
            batch.append((pid,kind,sid,category,generation,received,title,normalized(title),added,json.dumps(payload)))
            if len(batch)>=BATCH_ROWS: flush()
        flush()
        if not stored:
            # Empty/filtered/error responses never erase a working group.
            raise ValueError('category response contains no usable entries')
        if cancel(): raise InterruptedError('catalogue import cancelled')
        check_space(target)
        with db:
            for category in touched:
                db.execute('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO groups VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)',(pid,kind,category,category,0))
                db.execute('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO heads VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)',(pid,kind,category,generation,time.time()))
            db.execute('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO catalog VALUES(?,?,?,?)',(pid,kind,generation,time.time()))
        for category in touched: _prune(db,pid,kind,category)
        return dict(received=received,stored=stored,discarded=discarded,categories=sorted(touched))
    except BaseException:
        # Keep the previous head; remove only our uncommitted generation.
        try:
            with db: db.execute('DELETE FROM items_v2 WHERE pid=? AND kind=? AND generation=?',
                                (pid,kind,generation))
        except sqlite3.Error: pass
        raise
    finally: db.close()


def _prune(db,pid,kind,cid):
    while True:
        with db:
            result=db.execute('''DELETE FROM items_v2 WHERE rowid IN
              (SELECT i.rowid FROM items_v2 i WHERE pid=? AND kind=? AND cid=? AND NOT EXISTS
                (SELECT 1 FROM heads h WHERE h.pid=i.pid AND h.kind=i.kind AND h.cid=i.cid
                 AND h.generation=i.generation) LIMIT 256)''',(pid,kind,cid))
        if result.rowcount<256: break


def sync_state(pid,kind,filename=None):
    db=connect(filename)
    if db is None: return []
    try:
        if not db.execute("SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE name='sync_status'").fetchone(): return []
        return [dict(r) for r in db.execute('SELECT * FROM sync_status WHERE pid=? AND kind=? ORDER BY updated DESC',(pid,kind))]
    finally: db.close()


def _sync_note(pid,kind,cid,code,counts=None,exc=None,filename=None):
    from import_budget import safe_failure
    db=connect(filename,write=True)
    counts=counts or {}
    try:
        with db: db.execute('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO sync_status VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',
            (pid,kind,cid,code,time.time(),counts.get('received',0),counts.get('stored',0),counts.get('discarded',0),
             json.dumps(safe_failure(exc)) if exc else ''))
    finally: db.close()


def sync_kind(portal,client,kind,preferred='',force=False,cancel=lambda:False,filename=None,cached_only=False,max_groups=None,requested_at=None,only_categories=None):
    """One kind, enabled categories first, category API only; safe offline fallback."""
    from group_selection import enabled_ids
    import uuid
    pid=str(portal['id']); action,group_action,_=CATALOGS[kind]
    if not portal.get({'live':'include_live','vod':'include_vod','series':'include_series'}[kind],True): return
    db=connect(filename,write=True);owner=uuid.uuid4().hex
    try:
        with db:
            lease=db.execute('SELECT until FROM sync_leases WHERE pid=? AND kind=?',(pid,kind)).fetchone()
            if lease and lease[0]>time.time(): return
            db.execute('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO sync_leases VALUES(?,?,?,?)',(pid,kind,owner,time.time()+330))
        groups=client.get_cached_catalog(group_action)
        if force and not cached_only:
            fresh=client._get_json(group_action,force_refresh=True)
            if isinstance(fresh,list) and fresh: groups=fresh
        if not isinstance(groups,list) and not cached_only:
            groups=client._get_json(group_action)
        if not isinstance(groups,list): raise FileNotFoundError('Category metadata unavailable')
        allowed=enabled_ids(pid,kind,groups)
        if only_categories is not None:allowed=set(allowed)&set(only_categories)
        active=[g for g in groups if str(g.get('category_id')) in allowed and (only_categories is None or str(g.get('category_id')) in only_categories)]
        active.sort(key=lambda g:str(g['category_id'])!=str(preferred))
        with db:
            db.executemany('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO groups VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)',[
                (pid,kind,str(g['category_id']),str(g.get('category_name') or g['category_id']),i) for i,g in enumerate(groups)])
        completed=set();processed=0
        for group in active:
            if cancel(): return
            cid=str(group['category_id'])
            if cid in completed: continue
            head=db.execute('SELECT updated FROM heads WHERE pid=? AND kind=? AND cid=?',(pid,kind,cid)).fetchone()
            if head and ((not force and time.time()-head[0]<12*3600) or
                         (requested_at is not None and head[0]>=requested_at)): continue
            prior=db.execute('SELECT code,updated FROM sync_status WHERE pid=? AND kind=? AND cid=?',(pid,kind,cid)).fetchone()
            if requested_at is not None and prior and prior[0] in ('FAILED','CANCELLED') and prior[1]>=requested_at: continue
            if max_groups is not None and processed>=max_groups: return True
            processed+=1
            with db: db.execute('UPDATE sync_leases SET until=? WHERE pid=? AND kind=? AND owner=?',(time.time()+330,pid,kind,owner))
            _sync_note(pid,kind,cid,'INDEXING',filename=filename)
            try:
                def progress(received,stored,discarded):

                    counts=import_group(pid,kind,cid,entries,filename,cancel,progress,allowed)
                except (OSError,ConnectionError,TimeoutError):

                    # scanned once for ALL active groups, never once per group.
                    counts=import_group(pid,kind,cid,client.iter_catalog(action,cid,cached_only=True,cancel=cancel),
                                        filename,cancel,progress,allowed)
                completed.update(counts['categories'])
                for category in counts['categories']:
                    _sync_note(pid,kind,category,'READY',counts,filename=filename)
            except Exception as exc:
                _sync_note(pid,kind,cid,'CANCELLED' if isinstance(exc,InterruptedError) else 'FAILED',exc=exc,filename=filename)
                # Other enabled groups can succeed independently.
    finally:
        with db: db.execute('DELETE FROM sync_leases WHERE pid=? AND kind=? AND owner=?',(pid,kind,owner))
        db.close()

    """Small persisted intent, consumed by one service worker. No network."""
    if kind not in CATALOGS or portal.get('type') not in ('xtream','m3u','stb'): return
    db=connect(filename,write=True,timeout=0.05)
    try:
        with db:

              ON CONFLICT(pid,kind) DO UPDATE SET priority=min(priority,excluded.priority),
              preferred=CASE WHEN excluded.priority<=priority THEN excluded.preferred ELSE preferred END,
              force=max(force,excluded.force),
              requested=CASE WHEN excluded.force=1 THEN excluded.requested ELSE requested END''',
              (str(portal['id']),kind,int(priority),str(preferred),int(force),time.time()))
    finally: db.close()

"""Local, versioned SQLite catalog. Writers run in workers; readers never HTTP.

The index contains IDs and provider metadata, never playable stream URLs.
No dependency on SQLite FTS/JSON extensions (not guaranteed by Android Kodi).
"""
import hashlib
import json
import os
import sqlite3
import time
import unicodedata

CATALOGS={'live':('get_live_streams','get_live_categories','stream_id'),
          'vod':('get_vod_streams','get_vod_categories','stream_id'),
          'series':('get_series','get_series_categories','series_id')}
FIELDS=('name','stream_icon','cover','cover_big','movie_image','backdrop_path','plot','description',
        'year','releaseDate','genre','rating','rating_5based','duration','duration_secs',
        'container_extension','epg_channel_id','source_key','series_flat',
        'language','languages','quality','video_quality','width','height',
        'num_seasons','season_count','seasons_count','original_name','original_title')
BATCH_ROWS=256


def normalized(value):
    value=unicodedata.normalize('NFKD',str(value or '').casefold())
    return ' '.join(''.join(c for c in value if not unicodedata.combining(c)).split())


def path():
    from utils import addon_data_dir
    return os.path.join(addon_data_dir(),'library_v1.sqlite')


def connect(filename=None, write=False,timeout=2):
    filename=filename or path()
    if not write and not os.path.isfile(filename): return None
    db=sqlite3.connect(filename,timeout=timeout)
    db.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
    if write:
        from import_budget import check_space
        check_space(filename)
        db.execute('PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL')
        db.execute('PRAGMA max_page_count=2147483646')
        db.executescript('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS catalog(
          pid TEXT, kind TEXT, revision TEXT, updated REAL, PRIMARY KEY(pid,kind));
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS groups(pid TEXT, kind TEXT, cid TEXT, title TEXT,
          ordinal INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(pid,kind,cid));
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS titles(pid TEXT, kind TEXT, sid TEXT, cid TEXT,
          ordinal INTEGER, title TEXT, search TEXT, added INTEGER, payload TEXT,
          PRIMARY KEY(pid,kind,sid));
          CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS category_titles ON titles(pid,kind,cid,ordinal);
          CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS recent_titles ON titles(pid,kind,added DESC,ordinal);
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS heads(pid TEXT,kind TEXT,cid TEXT,generation TEXT,
            updated REAL,PRIMARY KEY(pid,kind,cid));
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS items_v2(pid TEXT,kind TEXT,sid TEXT,cid TEXT,generation TEXT,
            ordinal INTEGER,title TEXT,search TEXT,added INTEGER,payload TEXT,
            PRIMARY KEY(pid,kind,cid,generation,sid));
          CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS group_order_v2 ON items_v2(pid,kind,cid,generation,ordinal);
          CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS recent_v2 ON items_v2(pid,kind,added DESC);
          CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS identity_v2 ON items_v2(pid,kind,sid);
          CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS readable_titles AS
            SELECT i.pid,i.kind,i.sid,i.cid,i.ordinal,i.title,i.search,i.added,i.payload
              FROM items_v2 i JOIN heads h USING(pid,kind,cid,generation)
            UNION ALL SELECT t.* FROM titles t WHERE NOT EXISTS
              (SELECT 1 FROM heads h WHERE h.pid=t.pid AND h.kind=t.kind AND h.cid=t.cid);
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sync_status(pid TEXT,kind TEXT,cid TEXT,code TEXT,
            updated REAL,received INTEGER,stored INTEGER,discarded INTEGER,error TEXT,
            PRIMARY KEY(pid,kind,cid));
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sync_requests(pid TEXT,kind TEXT,priority INTEGER,
            preferred TEXT,force INTEGER,requested REAL,PRIMARY KEY(pid,kind));
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sync_leases(pid TEXT,kind TEXT,owner TEXT,until REAL,
            PRIMARY KEY(pid,kind));''')
    return db


def revision(client, actions):
    """File metadata, not repeated deserialization of huge catalog JSON files."""
    from utils import cache_dir, _private_cache_dir, addon_data_dir
    roots=set((cache_dir(),_private_cache_dir()))
    paths=[os.path.join(root,client._cache_key(a)+'.json') for root in roots for a in actions]
    paths.append(os.path.join(addon_data_dir(),'xtreammate_groups.json'))
    values=[]
    for filename in paths:
        try:
            st=os.stat(filename); values.append((filename,st.st_mtime_ns,st.st_size))
        except OSError: values.append((filename,0,0))
    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(sorted(values)).encode()).hexdigest()


def replace_catalog(pid,kind,entries,groups,allowed=None,seen=None,revision_id='',filename=None):
    from latest_media import added_timestamp
    if entries is None or isinstance(entries,(str,bytes,dict)): return False
    _,_,id_key=CATALOGS[kind]
    allowed=None if allowed is None else set(map(str,allowed))
    def rows():
        unique=set()
        for ordinal,item in enumerate(entries):
            if not isinstance(item,dict): continue
            sid=str(item.get(id_key) or ''); cid=str(item.get('category_id') or '')
            if not sid or sid in unique or (allowed is not None and cid not in allowed): continue
            unique.add(sid)
            title=str(item.get('name') or sid)[:512]
            payload={k:(item[k][:4096] if isinstance(item[k],str) else item[k][:8] if isinstance(item[k],list) else item[k])
                     for k in FIELDS if k in item}
            payload.update(sid=sid,category_id=cid,name=title,kind=kind)
            added=added_timestamp(item.get('added')) or added_timestamp(item.get('date_added')) or (seen or {}).get(sid)
            payload['added_at']=added
            yield (str(pid),kind,sid,cid,ordinal,title,normalized(title),added,json.dumps(payload))
    db=connect(filename,write=True)
    try:
        with db:
            db.execute('DELETE FROM heads WHERE pid=? AND kind=?',(pid,kind))
            db.execute('DELETE FROM items_v2 WHERE pid=? AND kind=?',(pid,kind))
            db.execute('DELETE FROM titles WHERE pid=? AND kind=?',(pid,kind))
            db.execute('DELETE FROM groups WHERE pid=? AND kind=?',(pid,kind))
            db.executemany('INSERT INTO titles VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',rows())
            db.executemany('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO groups VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)',[
                (pid,kind,str(g['category_id']),str(g.get('category_name') or g['category_id']),i)
                for i,g in enumerate(groups or []) if isinstance(g,dict) and g.get('category_id') is not None
                and (allowed is None or str(g['category_id']) in allowed)])
            db.execute('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO catalog VALUES(?,?,?,?)',(pid,kind,revision_id,time.time()))
        return True
    finally: db.close()


def refresh(portal,client,kinds=None):
    from group_selection import enabled_ids,load
    from latest_media import first_seen
    for kind in (kinds or CATALOGS):
        action,group_action,_=CATALOGS[kind]
        if not portal.get({'live':'include_live','vod':'include_vod','series':'include_series'}[kind],True):
            replace_catalog(portal['id'],kind,[],[])
            continue
        rev=revision(client,(action,group_action))
        state=Reader(portal['id']).state(kind)
        if state and state['revision']==rev: continue
        entries=client.get_cached_catalog(action)
        if not isinstance(entries,list): continue  # Keep previous valid snapshot.
        if not entries and state: continue  # Empty provider result must not empty widgets.
        groups=client.get_cached_catalog(group_action)
        if not isinstance(groups,list):
            groups=[{'category_id':cid,'category_name':cid} for cid in dict.fromkeys(
                str(e.get('category_id') or '') for e in entries if isinstance(e,dict))]
        allowed=enabled_ids(portal['id'],kind,groups)
        seen=first_seen(client._cache_key(action),action,entries) if kind!='live' else {}
        replace_catalog(portal['id'],kind,entries,groups,allowed,seen,rev)


class IndexReadError(RuntimeError):
    pass


class Reader:
    def __init__(self,pid,filename=None,timeout=2,query_seconds=None):
        self.pid,self.filename=str(pid),filename
        self._selections={}
        self.timeout,self.query_seconds=timeout,query_seconds

    def _filter(self,kind):
        from group_selection import enabled_ids
        groups=self._query('SELECT cid FROM groups WHERE pid=? AND kind=?',(self.pid,kind))
        self._selections[kind]=enabled_ids(self.pid,kind,[{'category_id':g['cid']} for g in groups])
        return ' AND cid IN (SELECT cid FROM selected_categories)'

    def _query(self,sql,args=(),kind=None):
        db=None
        try:
            db=connect(self.filename, timeout=self.timeout)
            if db is None: return []
            # A large catalogue or a temporarily locked legacy database must
            # not monopolize a skin widget/UI invocation. No partial result is
            # published; the caller receives an explicit, retryable error.
            if self.query_seconds is not None:
                deadline=time.monotonic()+self.query_seconds
                db.set_progress_handler(lambda: int(time.monotonic()>=deadline),1000)
            if 'titles' in sql and db.execute("SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE name='readable_titles'").fetchone():
                sql=sql.replace('FROM titles','FROM readable_titles')
            if kind is not None:
                db.execute('CREATE TEMP TABLE selected_categories(cid TEXT PRIMARY KEY)')
                db.executemany('INSERT INTO selected_categories VALUES(?)',[(cid,) for cid in self._selections[kind]])
            return [dict(r) for r in db.execute(sql,args)]
        except sqlite3.Error as exc: raise IndexReadError(type(exc).__name__) from exc
        finally:
            if db is not None: db.close()

    def state(self,kind):
        rows=self._query('SELECT * FROM catalog WHERE pid=? AND kind=?',(self.pid,kind))
        return rows[0] if rows else None

    def groups(self,kind):
        return self._query('SELECT * FROM groups WHERE pid=? AND kind=?'+self._filter(kind)+' ORDER BY ordinal',(self.pid,kind),kind)

    def page(self,kind,query='',category=None,recent=False,offset=0,limit=48,pin=None,include_undated=False):
        where='pid=? AND kind=?'+self._filter(kind); args=[self.pid,kind]
        terms=[];term_args=[]
        for token in normalized(query).split():
            terms.append("search LIKE ? ESCAPE '\\'")
            term_args.append('%'+token.replace('\\','\\\\').replace('%','\\%').replace('_','\\_')+'%')
        title_where=' AND '.join(terms) or '1'
        genre=None
        if query and kind in ('vod','series'):
            from genre_search import clause
            genre=clause(self,kind,query)
        if genre:
            where+=' AND (('+title_where+') OR ('+genre[0]+'))'
            args+=term_args+genre[1]
        elif terms:
            where+=' AND '+title_where;args+=term_args
        if category is not None: where+=' AND cid=?'; args.append(str(category))
        if recent and not include_undated: where+=' AND added IS NOT NULL'
        counts=self._query('SELECT count(DISTINCT sid) AS n FROM titles AS results WHERE '+where,args,kind)
        total=counts[0]['n'] if counts else 0
        order='added IS NULL,added DESC,ordinal' if recent else 'ordinal'
        if genre:
            order='CASE WHEN search=? THEN 0 WHEN '+title_where+' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,'+order
            args=args+[normalized(query)]+term_args
        if pin:
            order='CASE WHEN sid=? THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,'+order
            args=args[:-(1+len(term_args))]+[str(pin)]+args[-(1+len(term_args)):] if genre else args+[str(pin)]
        rows=self._query('SELECT payload FROM titles AS results WHERE '+where+' GROUP BY sid ORDER BY '+order+' LIMIT ? OFFSET ?',
                         args+[max(1,min(int(limit),100)),max(0,int(offset))],kind)
        return [json.loads(r['payload']) for r in rows],total

    def get(self,kind,sid):
        rows=self._query('SELECT payload FROM titles WHERE pid=? AND kind=? AND sid=?'+self._filter(kind),(self.pid,kind,str(sid)),kind)
        return json.loads(rows[0]['payload']) if rows else None

    def position(self,kind,sid,category):
        """Read-only ordinal position in one allowed group; never pin/reorder."""
        where='pid=? AND kind=? AND cid=?'+self._filter(kind)
        args=[self.pid,kind,str(category)]
        rows=self._query('SELECT MIN(ordinal) AS n FROM titles WHERE '+where+' AND sid=?',args+[str(sid)],kind)
        ordinal=rows[0]['n'] if rows else None
        if ordinal is None:return None
        rows=self._query('SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sid) AS n FROM titles WHERE '+where+' AND ordinal<?',args+[ordinal],kind)
        return rows[0]['n'] if rows else None

    def rail(self,kind,offset=0,limit=24,keep=100):
        keep=max(24,min(int(keep),500))
        rows,total=self.page(kind,recent=True,include_undated=True,offset=offset,limit=min(limit,max(1,keep-offset)))
        return (rows if offset<keep else []),min(total,keep)


def initial_group(portal,groups,start_channel=None,last=''):
    allowed={str(g.get('cid',g.get('category_id',''))) for g in groups}
    candidates=[str((start_channel or {}).get('category_id') or ''),
                str(portal.get('start_group_id') or ''),str(last)]
    return next((cid for cid in candidates if cid in allowed),
                str(groups[0].get('cid',groups[0].get('category_id',''))) if groups else '')


def import_group(pid,kind,cid,entries,filename=None,cancel=lambda:False,progress=None,allowed=None):
    """Batch-committed staging; one small head swap exposes a complete group.

    Staging and previous generation coexist until validation finishes. A crash
    never publishes half JSON; a later sync restarts from the category endpoint.
    Unique SQLite keys replace unbounded Python duplicate/first-seen sets.
    """
    import uuid
    from latest_media import added_timestamp
    from import_budget import check_space
    cid,pid=str(cid),str(pid)
    generation=uuid.uuid4().hex
    db=connect(filename,write=True); target=filename or path()
    action,_,id_key=CATALOGS[kind]
    known_categories={r[0] for r in db.execute('SELECT cid FROM heads WHERE pid=? AND kind=? UNION SELECT cid FROM titles WHERE pid=? AND kind=?',(pid,kind,pid,kind))}
    received=stored=discarded=0; batch=[];touched=set()
    allowed={cid} if allowed is None else set(map(str,allowed))
    def flush():
        nonlocal stored
        if not batch: return
        check_space(target,sum(len(row[-1]) for row in batch)*4)
        previous_changes=db.total_changes
        with db: db.executemany('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO items_v2 VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',batch)
        stored+=db.total_changes-previous_changes
        batch.clear()
        if progress: progress(received,stored,discarded)
    try:
        # Clean only this group's abandoned, invisible generations. Bounded
        # deletion also avoids a giant cleanup transaction after a crash.
        _prune(db,pid,kind,cid)
        for item in entries:
            if cancel(): raise InterruptedError('catalogue import cancelled')
            received+=1
            if progress and received % BATCH_ROWS == 0: progress(received,stored,discarded)
            if not isinstance(item,dict): continue
            category=str(item.get('category_id') or '')
            if category not in allowed: discarded+=1;continue
            sid=str(item.get(id_key) or '')[:256]
            if not sid: continue
            title=str(item.get('name') or sid)[:512]
            payload={}
            for key in FIELDS:
                value=item.get(key)
                if isinstance(value,str): payload[key]=value[:4096]
                elif isinstance(value,(int,float,bool)) or value is None: payload[key]=value
                elif isinstance(value,list): payload[key]=[str(v)[:4096] for v in value[:8] if isinstance(v,(str,int,float))]
            added=added_timestamp(item.get('added')) or added_timestamp(item.get('date_added'))
            if not added:
                previous=db.execute('SELECT added FROM readable_titles WHERE pid=? AND kind=? AND sid=? LIMIT 1',
                                    (pid,kind,sid)).fetchone()
                added=previous[0] if previous else (int(time.time()) if category in known_categories else None)
            payload.update(sid=sid,category_id=category,name=title,kind=kind,added_at=added)
            touched.add(category)
            batch.append((pid,kind,sid,category,generation,received,title,normalized(title),added,json.dumps(payload)))
            if len(batch)>=BATCH_ROWS: flush()
        flush()
        if not stored:
            # Empty/filtered/error responses never erase a working group.
            raise ValueError('category response contains no usable entries')
        if cancel(): raise InterruptedError('catalogue import cancelled')
        check_space(target)
        with db:
            for category in touched:
                db.execute('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO groups VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)',(pid,kind,category,category,0))
                db.execute('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO heads VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)',(pid,kind,category,generation,time.time()))
            db.execute('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO catalog VALUES(?,?,?,?)',(pid,kind,generation,time.time()))
        for category in touched: _prune(db,pid,kind,category)
        return dict(received=received,stored=stored,discarded=discarded,categories=sorted(touched))
    except BaseException:
        # Keep the previous head; remove only our uncommitted generation.
        try:
            with db: db.execute('DELETE FROM items_v2 WHERE pid=? AND kind=? AND generation=?',
                                (pid,kind,generation))
        except sqlite3.Error: pass
        raise
    finally: db.close()


def _prune(db,pid,kind,cid):
    while True:
        with db:
            result=db.execute('''DELETE FROM items_v2 WHERE rowid IN
              (SELECT i.rowid FROM items_v2 i WHERE pid=? AND kind=? AND cid=? AND NOT EXISTS
                (SELECT 1 FROM heads h WHERE h.pid=i.pid AND h.kind=i.kind AND h.cid=i.cid
                 AND h.generation=i.generation) LIMIT 256)''',(pid,kind,cid))
        if result.rowcount<256: break


def sync_state(pid,kind,filename=None):
    db=connect(filename)
    if db is None: return []
    try:
        if not db.execute("SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE name='sync_status'").fetchone(): return []
        return [dict(r) for r in db.execute('SELECT * FROM sync_status WHERE pid=? AND kind=? ORDER BY updated DESC',(pid,kind))]
    finally: db.close()


def _sync_note(pid,kind,cid,code,counts=None,exc=None,filename=None):
    from import_budget import safe_failure
    db=connect(filename,write=True)
    counts=counts or {}
    try:
        with db: db.execute('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO sync_status VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',
            (pid,kind,cid,code,time.time(),counts.get('received',0),counts.get('stored',0),counts.get('discarded',0),
             json.dumps(safe_failure(exc)) if exc else ''))
    finally: db.close()


def sync_kind(portal,client,kind,preferred='',force=False,cancel=lambda:False,filename=None,cached_only=False,max_groups=None,requested_at=None,only_categories=None):
    """One kind, enabled categories first, category API only; safe offline fallback."""
    from group_selection import enabled_ids
    import uuid
    pid=str(portal['id']); action,group_action,_=CATALOGS[kind]
    if not portal.get({'live':'include_live','vod':'include_vod','series':'include_series'}[kind],True): return
    db=connect(filename,write=True);owner=uuid.uuid4().hex
    try:
        with db:
            lease=db.execute('SELECT until FROM sync_leases WHERE pid=? AND kind=?',(pid,kind)).fetchone()
            if lease and lease[0]>time.time(): return
            db.execute('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO sync_leases VALUES(?,?,?,?)',(pid,kind,owner,time.time()+330))
        groups=client.get_cached_catalog(group_action)
        if force and not cached_only:
            fresh=client._get_json(group_action,force_refresh=True)
            if isinstance(fresh,list) and fresh: groups=fresh
        if not isinstance(groups,list) and not cached_only:
            groups=client._get_json(group_action)
        if not isinstance(groups,list): raise FileNotFoundError('Category metadata unavailable')
        if only_categories is not None:
            missing=set(map(str,only_categories))-{str(g.get('category_id')) for g in groups}
            if missing and not cached_only:
                fresh=client._get_json(group_action,force_refresh=True)
                if isinstance(fresh,list):groups=fresh
                missing=set(map(str,only_categories))-{str(g.get('category_id')) for g in groups}
            if missing:raise FileNotFoundError('Requested category metadata unavailable')
        allowed=enabled_ids(pid,kind,groups)
        if only_categories is not None:allowed=set(allowed)&set(only_categories)
        active=[g for g in groups if str(g.get('category_id')) in allowed and (only_categories is None or str(g.get('category_id')) in only_categories)]
        active.sort(key=lambda g:str(g['category_id'])!=str(preferred))
        with db:
            db.executemany('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO groups VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)',[
                (pid,kind,str(g['category_id']),str(g.get('category_name') or g['category_id']),i) for i,g in enumerate(groups)])
        completed=set();processed=0
        for group in active:
            if cancel(): return
            cid=str(group['category_id'])
            if cid in completed: continue
            head=db.execute('SELECT updated FROM heads WHERE pid=? AND kind=? AND cid=?',(pid,kind,cid)).fetchone()
            if head and ((not force and time.time()-head[0]<12*3600) or
                         (requested_at is not None and head[0]>=requested_at)): continue
            prior=db.execute('SELECT code,updated FROM sync_status WHERE pid=? AND kind=? AND cid=?',(pid,kind,cid)).fetchone()
            if requested_at is not None and prior and prior[0] in ('FAILED','CANCELLED') and prior[1]>=requested_at: continue
            if max_groups is not None and processed>=max_groups: return True
            processed+=1
            with db: db.execute('UPDATE sync_leases SET until=? WHERE pid=? AND kind=? AND owner=?',(time.time()+330,pid,kind,owner))
            _sync_note(pid,kind,cid,'INDEXING',filename=filename)
            try:
                def progress(received,stored,discarded):
                    _sync_note(pid,kind,cid,'INDEXING',dict(received=received,stored=stored,discarded=discarded),filename=filename)
                try:
                    entries=client.iter_catalog(action,cid,cached_only=cached_only,cancel=cancel)
                    counts=import_group(pid,kind,cid,entries,filename,cancel,progress,allowed)
                except (OSError,ConnectionError,TimeoutError):
                    if cached_only or head: raise
                    # Cold/offline upgrade only. A global cached array is
                    # scanned once for ALL active groups, never once per group.
                    counts=import_group(pid,kind,cid,client.iter_catalog(action,cid,cached_only=True,cancel=cancel),
                                        filename,cancel,progress,allowed)
                completed.update(counts['categories'])
                for category in counts['categories']:
                    _sync_note(pid,kind,category,'READY',counts,filename=filename)
            except Exception as exc:
                _sync_note(pid,kind,cid,'CANCELLED' if isinstance(exc,InterruptedError) else 'FAILED',exc=exc,filename=filename)
                # Other enabled groups can succeed independently.
    finally:
        with db: db.execute('DELETE FROM sync_leases WHERE pid=? AND kind=? AND owner=?',(pid,kind,owner))
        db.close()


def request_sync(portal,kind,preferred='',priority=20,force=False,filename=None):
    """Small persisted intent, consumed by one service worker. No network."""
    if kind not in CATALOGS or portal.get('type') not in ('xtream','m3u','stb'): return
    db=connect(filename,write=True,timeout=0.05)
    try:
        with db:
            db.execute('''INSERT INTO sync_requests VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)

"""Own Kodi WindowXML: real horizontal rail, groups/grid and detail view.

Native XML controls dispatch onClick, unlike programmatic WindowDialog. Data,
metadata and images are prepared by bounded workers; callbacks only use views.
"""
from localization import tr
from owner_dispatch import OwnerDispatch,native_init,open_owned_window
from media_search import SearchMixin
from detail_menu import DetailMenuMixin
import json
import os
import queue
import threading
import sqlite3
import time
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor

import xbmc
import xbmcgui
import xbmcaddon

PAGE=24
WINDOW_ITEMS=240


class MediaView(DetailMenuMixin,SearchMixin,OwnerDispatch):
    def configure(self,router,portal,kind,sid='',favourites=False):
        self._configure_owner()
        from theme_render import snapshot
        self._theme=snapshot()
        self._dispatch=getattr(router,'_navigation_dispatch','')
        self._return_home=False
        self.router,self.portal,self.kind=router,portal,kind
        self.initial_sid=sid
        self.favourites_only=favourites
        self.mode='landing';self.category='';self.offset=0;self.total=0
        self.rails={111:[],112:[]};self._art_revision=0
        self.rows=[];self.groups=[];self.selected=None;self.episodes=[];self.actions=[]
        self._positions={};self._previous=None;self._last_position=0;self._cols=4
        self._ready=False;self._closed=False;self._generation=0;self._play_intent=''
        self._watch_stop=threading.Event();self._watch_thread=None;self._pending_future=None
        self._opened_at=time.monotonic();self._seen_revision=''
        self._catalog_missing=True
        self._catalog_update=None
        self._mode_focus={};self._next_route=None
        self._focus_pending=None
        self._restore_focus=None;self._season_cursor=0
        self._episode_cursor={};self._leaving=False
        self._landing_loaded=False
        self._rail_focus={}
        self._art_selected=None;self._art_diagnostic=None
        self._append_future=None;self._append_context=None;self._append_failed=False
        self._append_advance=None;self._grid_return=None
        self._playback_waiting=False;self._playback_seen=False;self._autoplay_root=''
        self._episode_refs={};self.next_episode=None;self._episode_last_pos=0;self._episode_next_key=None
        self._lock=threading.RLock();self._pool=ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2)
        self._art=queue.Queue(maxsize=3)
        self._art_thread=threading.Thread(target=self._art_loop,daemon=True,name='XCMate-art')
        self._art_thread.start()

    def _stop_media_only(self):
        from playback_exit import identity
        token=identity(xbmc.Player())
        if token and token[0]=='media':
            from exit_jobs import request
            return request(pid=self.portal['id'],expected=token,reason='USER_BACK')
        return False

    def setFocusId(self,control_id):
        if self._closed:return
        rail=getattr(self,'_navigation_rail',None)
        if rail and rail.active:return
        requested=control_id
        # Native setVisible/enabled flags may lag one GUI frame. Keep the
        # intended target instead of committing a temporary fallback to Search.
        eligible=self._valid_focus(native=False)
        if control_id not in eligible:
            primary=300 if self.mode=='detail' else 330 if self.mode in ('episodes','seasons') else None
            control_id=primary if primary is not None else next(iter(eligible),None)
        if control_id is None:return
        valid=self._valid_focus()
        if self.mode=='search':
            from search_navigation import focus_details
            focus_details(self,requested,eligible,valid)
            # Native XML can process another key before visibility catches up.
            # Never leave old 400 -> 120 landing edges live during that frame.
            for cid in (400,700,701,702,710,720,721):
                control=self.getControl(cid);control.setNavigation(control,control,control,control)
        if control_id not in valid:
            if (self.mode in ('detail','seasons','episodes') and control_id in (300,330,340,810,820)
                    or self.mode=='search' and control_id in eligible):
                self._mode_focus[self.mode]=control_id
                pending=(self.mode,control_id)
                if self._focus_pending!=pending:
                    from window_navigation import trace
                    trace('FOCUS_DEFER',self.mode,control_id,self._dispatch)
                if self._focus_pending!=pending:self._focus_deadline=time.monotonic()+2
                self._focus_pending=pending
                return
            # Preserve established catalogue/landing navigation when a target
            # is genuinely disabled or its row has disappeared.
            if not valid:return
            control_id=self._mode_focus.get(self.mode,valid[0])
            if control_id not in valid:control_id=valid[0]
        deferred=self._focus_pending is not None
        self._focus_pending=None
        for pos,cid in enumerate(valid):
            control=self.getControl(cid)
            control.setNavigation(self.getControl(valid[max(0,pos-1)]),
                                  self.getControl(valid[min(len(valid)-1,pos+1)]),control,control)
        if 210 in valid:
            panel=self.getControl(210)
            panel.setNavigation(self.getControl(400),panel,panel,panel)
        super().setFocusId(control_id)
        if deferred:
            from window_navigation import trace
            trace('FOCUS_READY',self.mode,control_id,self._dispatch)
        if self.mode=='landing':
            first=next((cid for cid in (112,111,110) if cid in valid),120)
            cat=self.getControl(120);search=self.getControl(400);row=self.getControl(first)
            cat.setNavigation(cat,row,cat,search)
            search.setNavigation(search,row,cat,search)
            self._track_art_focus()
        if self.mode=='episodes':
            rows=self.getControl(330);search=self.getControl(400)
            target=self.getControl(340) if 340 in valid else rows
            rows.setNavigation(target,rows,rows,target)
            search.setNavigation(search,target,search,search)
            if 340 in valid:target.setNavigation(search,rows,rows,rows)
        self._nav_focus=control_id
        self._mode_focus[self.mode]=control_id

    def _resume_focus(self):
        # One nonblocking check per existing owner-pump tick. No GUI work on
        # workers, no additional loop, and no search click while focus is stale.
        if self._closed or self._leaving or self._playback_waiting and not getattr(self,'_detail_menu_open',False):return
        pending=self._focus_pending
        if pending is None:return
        if pending[0]!=self.mode:
            self._focus_pending=None;return
        if self.mode=='search' and time.monotonic()>=getattr(self,'_focus_deadline',float('inf')):
            self._focus_pending=None
            from search_navigation import mark
            mark('FOCUS_TIMEOUT',self.router,'media',getattr(self,'_search_correlation',''),pending[1],True)
            return
        if pending[1] in self._valid_focus():self.setFocusId(pending[1])

    def _valid_focus(self,native=True):
        if getattr(self,'_detail_menu_open',False):
            return [810] if not native or self.getControl(800).isVisible() and self.getControl(810).isVisible() else []
        candidates=([120,400,112,111,110] if self.mode=='landing' else
                    [200,210,400] if self.mode in ('grid','groups') else
                    [300,820,400] if self.mode=='detail' else [700,701,702,710,720,721,400] if self.mode=='search' else [330,340,400] if self.mode=='episodes' else [330,400])
        result=[]
        for cid in candidates:
            if cid==110 and not self.rows:continue
            if cid in (111,112) and not self.rails[cid]:continue
            if cid==200 and (not self.groups or self.mode=='grid' and self._cols==6):continue
            if cid==210 and not self.rows:continue
            if cid==300 and not self.actions:continue
            if cid==330 and not self.getControl(330).size():continue
            if cid==340 and self.next_episode is None:continue
            if cid==710 and (not getattr(self,'_search_rows',[]) or getattr(self,'_search_loading',False)):continue
            if cid==720 and not getattr(self,'_search_offset',0):continue
            if cid==721:
                section=getattr(self,'_search_data',{}).get(getattr(self,'_search_kind','vod'),{})
                if not section.get('total') or self._search_offset+len(self._search_rows)>=section['total']:continue
            control=self.getControl(cid)
            if not native or control.isVisible() and xbmc.getCondVisibility('Control.IsEnabled({})'.format(cid)) and xbmc.getCondVisibility('Control.IsVisible({})'.format(cid)):result.append(cid)
        return result

    @native_init
    def onInit(self):
        if getattr(self,'_returning39',False):return
        self.getControl(400).setLabel(tr(32586))
        self.getControl(501).setLabel(tr(32587))
        if self._ready and getattr(self,'_playback_origin39',None):
            # Fullscreen/Stop races must not reset the still-owned native view.
            self._poll_playback_return();return
        if self._ready and getattr(self,'_search_prompt',False):return
        if self._ready and self.mode=='search':
            from media_search import mark
            mark('SEARCH_RESUMED',getattr(self,'_search_correlation',''))
            self._show('search')
            if getattr(self,'_search_data',None):self._search_ready(self._search_data,resume=True)
            return
        if self._ready:
            if self._chain_active():return
            # onInit can be delivered during Kodi decoder/fullscreen startup.
            # Reinitialization is not an explicit Back/Stop or cancellation.
            self._playback_waiting=False;self._playback_seen=False
            self._generation+=1
            if self._pending_future is not None:self._pending_future.cancel()
            self._pending_future=None;self._pending_apply=None
            self._show(self.mode)
            if self.mode=='detail': self._detail_ready((self.selected,{'episodes':self._episode_raw()}))
            elif self.mode=='episodes': self._show_episodes()
            elif self.mode=='seasons':
                self._fill(330,self._season_rows());self.setFocusId(330)
            else:
                self._fill(200,[dict(name=g['title'],sid=g['cid']) for g in self.groups])
                self._page_ready((self.rows,self.total))
            return
        self._ready=True
        if getattr(self,'_search_root',False):
            # A root search has no landing/catalogue frame to initialize.
            from window_lifecycle import capture
            self._search_native_window=capture(self)
            self.mode='search';self._show('search')
            self.getControl(101).setLabel(tr(32586));return
        self._show('landing')
        self.getControl(101).setLabel('XCMate · '+(tr(32461) if self.kind=='vod' else tr(32462)))
        self.getControl(120).setLabel((tr(32403) if self.kind=='vod' else tr(32404))+tr(32492))
        self.getControl(102).setLabel(tr(32491))
        self._request(self._initial,self._initial_ready)
        self._start_watch()

    def _query_failed(self,exc):
        self._gui()
        if self.mode=='search':
            self._search_loading=False
            from media_search import mark
            mark('SEARCH_WORKER_FAILED',self._search_correlation)
        self.getControl(102).setLabel(tr(32610))

    def _initial(self):
        from media_catalog43 import Reader
        from catalog_sync import request
        reader=Reader(self.portal['id'])
        groups=reader.groups(self.kind)
        preferred=self.category or (groups[0]['cid'] if groups else '')
        if not reader.state(self.kind): request(self.portal,self.kind,preferred,priority=2)
        return reader,groups,reader.state(self.kind)

    def _initial_ready(self,value):
        self.reader,self.groups,state=value
        self._catalog_missing=not bool(state)
        self._seen_revision=(state or {}).get('revision','')
        self._fill(200,[dict(name=g['title'],sid=g['cid']) for g in self.groups])
        self.category=self.category if any(g['cid']==self.category for g in self.groups) else (self.groups[0]['cid'] if self.groups else '')
        if not state:
            self.getControl(102).setLabel(tr(32494))
            self.getControl(120).setLabel(tr(32495))
            self.setFocusId(120)
            return
        self.getControl(120).setLabel((tr(32403) if self.kind=='vod' else tr(32404))+tr(32492))
        if self.initial_sid:
            # The completion callback owns GUI, not SQL/profile IO. Widgets
            # resolve their one verified media ID on the existing data worker.
            reader,kind,sid=self.reader,self.kind,self.initial_sid
            self.initial_sid=''
            self._request(lambda:reader.get(kind,sid),lambda item:self._details(item) if item else self._page('landing',0))
            return
        self._page('landing',0)

    def _start_watch(self):
        if self._watch_thread is not None: return

        from exit_jobs import blocked

                if player.getVideoInfoTag().getUniqueID(UNIQUE_ID)==self._play_intent:self._playback_seen=True
                # A transient non-fullscreen frame is not a user exit.
                # Owned Back/Stop handlers publish the explicit stop/return.

            if not self._playback_seen:

                failed=failure(self._play_intent,self.portal['id'])
                expired=time.monotonic()-getattr(self,'_playback_started40',time.monotonic())>=20
                if not failed and not expired:return

                # A failed/never-started own resolver can be cancelled, but a

    def _play(self,item,kind,resume=False):
        from exit_jobs import blocked
        if blocked():

        self._cancel_chain()

                if self.mode=='episodes':
                    self.season=episode['season']

                    rows=[e for e in self.episodes if e['season']==self.season]
                    self._episode_cursor[self.season]=next(i for i,e in enumerate(rows) if e['sid']==episode['sid'])
        self._playback_waiting=True;self._playback_seen=False;self._playback_started40=time.monotonic()
        self._generation+=1
        if self._pending_future is not None:self._pending_future.cancel()
        self._pending_future=None;self._pending_apply=None
        from media_intent import begin
        self._play_intent=begin(self.portal['id'],kind,item['sid'])
        from media_portal44 import trace as trace_media

            self._origin_suspended40=True
            super().close()
        self._autoplay_root=self._play_intent if kind=='episode' else ''
        url=self.router.url(action='media_play',pid=self.portal['id'],kind=kind,sid=item['sid'],
            series_id=item.get('series_id'),season=item.get('season'),episode=item.get('episode'),intent=self._play_intent,resume='1' if resume else '0',
            autoplay='1' if kind=='episode' else '0',autoplay_chain=self._autoplay_root,origin44='search' if getattr(self,'_search_detail',False) else 'catalog')
        xbmc.executebuiltin('PlayMedia('+url+')')

    def _season_rows(self):
        from media_state import read,progress_key
        try: snapshot=read()['progress']
        except (ValueError,OSError,sqlite3.Error): snapshot=None
        rows=[]
        for season in self.seasons:
            episodes=[e for e in self.episodes if e['season']==season]
            values=[snapshot.get(progress_key(self.portal['id'],'episode',e['sid'],e['series_id'],season),{}) for e in episodes] if snapshot is not None else []
            watched=sum(bool(v.get('watched')) for v in values)
            status=tr(32520) if snapshot is None else tr(32525) if episodes and watched==len(episodes) else tr(32526) if any(v.get('position') or v.get('watched') for v in values) else tr(32527)
            rows.append(dict(name=tr(32523)+str(season)+' · '+str(watched)+'/'+str(len(episodes))+' · '+status,sid=str(season)))
        return rows

    def _show_episodes(self):
        self._show('episodes')
        from media_state import read,progress_key
        snapshot=read()['progress']
        self.visible_episodes=[e for e in self.episodes if e['season']==self.season]
        rows=[]
        for e in self.visible_episodes:
            saved=snapshot.get(progress_key(self.portal['id'],'episode',e['sid'],e['series_id'],e['season']),{})
            status=tr(32526) if saved.get('position') and not saved.get('watched') else ''
            duration=saved.get('duration',0);position=saved.get('position',0)
            if isinstance(duration,(int,float)) and isinstance(position,(int,float)) and duration>0:
                status+=' · {} %'.format(max(0,min(100,int(position/duration*100))))
            rows.append(dict(e,name='{} · {}{}'.format(e['episode'],e['name'],' · '+status if status else ''),_watched=bool(saved.get('watched'))))
